    org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<EgradxErrorResponse>
    EgradxApplicationExceptionHandler.handleSecurity(RuntimeException ex, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request)
    A security check refused the request, answered as egradx-auth answers its own: 401 SESSION_EXPIRED when a token was sent and refused (expired, signed out everywhere) so a client renews it, 401 NOT_AUTHENTICATED for no one signed in, 403 ACCESS_DENIED for someone signed in.
